start: Member app, Gym tab, not in a gym; the gym list has this number and first name with a plan running today

steps.action: Tap "Find my gym with my number", type "Your mobile number" and "Your first name, as your gym has it", press "Check with WhatsApp"
user_sees: "Send the message in WhatsApp"
WhatsApp opens with a short message to MettleUp
must_not: The search run on a typed number before it is proven

steps.action: Send the message and come back to the app
user_sees: "Looking for your gym..." then "You are a member of {gym}" and "Your plan runs until {date}."
must_not: A plan price, dues or visits shown
A gym where the plan ended

user_sees: The member is in the gym; the number is linked to the gym's list
must_not: A desk check still asked for the same number

start: Member app, first start, phone number sign-in

steps.action: Sign in with the phone number and prove it on WhatsApp
user_sees: The gym found for that number and first name, ready to join
must_not: A different gym's member shown
The number used for anything but finding the gym

steps.action: Type a first name that is not the one on the gym list
user_sees: "We did not find your gym"
"We look only for a plan that runs today, under the number and first name your gym has for you."
must_not: The gym shown for a wrong name

steps.action: Search a sixth time with the same check
user_sees: "Too many searches with this check. Tap Start again."
must_not: A sixth answer

steps.action: Send the WhatsApp message from another number
user_sees: "The message came from a different number. Send it from the WhatsApp of the number you typed."
must_not: The check passed for the typed number

start: Member app, gym found and joined, the same check used once to link

steps.action: The app links the number after the join
user_sees: The member is linked; a waiting desk request for this member is closed as "Number checked"
must_not: The desk request still waiting

steps.action: The same proof is used again for a link
user_sees: "The check ran out of time. Tap Start again."
must_not: A second link with a used proof

start: A number that once belonged to someone else, now held by a new person with another first name

steps.action: The new holder proves the number and searches with their own first name
user_sees: "We did not find your gym"
must_not: The old holder's gym shown
Any gym found from a typed number that was never proven

steps.action: Tap "Tell my gym" and type a gym name and city
user_sees: The share menu with a message about MettleUp
"If you type your gym’s name and city, the MettleUp team may contact your gym. We never share your number."
must_not: The member's number sent in the lead

start: Member app, Gym tab, not in a gym; the gym list has this number and first name, coming on a pass

steps.action: Find my gym with the number and first name, prove it on WhatsApp
user_sees: "You are a member of {gym}"
"You train there on a pass."
must_not: A plan end date made up for a pass

user_sees: The member is in the gym and linked
must_not: The pass company's name or dues shown to the member

start: Member app, first start, phone number sign-in, a pass member

steps.action: Sign in with the phone number and prove it
user_sees: The gym found with "You train there on a pass."
must_not: Not found only because there is no plan

start: Member app, Find my gym, a pass member the gym archived

steps.action: Search with the right number and first name
user_sees: "We did not find your gym"
must_not: An archived or deleted list entry shown as a gym

user_sees: "Type your first name, as your gym has it."
must_not: A search with no name

start: Member app, a pass member joined but typed a different first name in the app than the gym list has

steps.action: The app links the number after the join
user_sees: A word that the name does not match the gym's list
must_not: The number linked to someone else on the list

steps.action: Start again with the right first name
user_sees: The link goes through
must_not: The first proof used up by the refused try

start: Member app, Find my gym, a pass member

steps.action: Read the lines under the form
user_sees: "Your number is checked once and is not kept for this."
"We only show you your own gym."
must_not: The member's number kept in the search log
